description: Measurement map: how NLP/ML literature operationalized each text-observable causal-graph node, organized by the orchestrator from the phase-2 Sonnet search (22 queries, websearch snippets). runner_implementable = usable inside evalweaver's runner namespace (re, math, collections, string, statistics, unicodedata + embedded word lists; no imports, no models).
runner_constraints: stdlib-only; embedded lexicons OK; embeddings/LMs/parsers NOT available — canonical embedding methods recorded as future_work.

canonical.name: DSI (mean pairwise BERT distance, layers 6-7)
canonical.note: up to 72% variance in human ratings

runner_implementable.name: TF/bag-of-words cosine or Jaccard distance between sentences
runner_implementable.recipe: Counter over content tokens per sentence; cosine via dot/norms in math
runner_implementable.weakness: ignores synonymy; lexical variation reads as semantic distance

runner_implementable.name: PMI-style co-occurrence distance
runner_implementable.recipe: PMI = log2(P(x,y)/(P(x)P(y))) from an embedded count table

runner_implementable.name: semantic-field mixing
runner_implementable.recipe: count distinct hand-listed semantic fields (nature/machine/body/food/domestic/weather...) touched by the text's nouns
runner_implementable.weakness: coarse; coverage limited to listed fields

runner_implementable.name: n-gram / bigram transition surprisal
runner_implementable.recipe: P(w_t|w_{t-1}) from embedded bigram counts, Laplace smoothing; -log2

runner_implementable.name: Zipf pseudo-surprisal
runner_implementable.recipe: -log10 count-per-billion from embedded frequency tiers; mean over content words
runner_implementable.weakness: context-blind — IS the frequency confound (see novelty_vs_frequency_confound)

canonical.name: Selectional preference violation (Fass met*; MisNet MIP+SPV)

runner_implementable.name: concreteness contrast topic-vs-vehicle
runner_implementable.recipe: |concreteness(topic) - concreteness(vehicle)| via embedded concreteness lexicon; abstract-topic + concrete-vehicle asymmetry flags figurative use
runner_implementable.weakness: topic/vehicle identification is heuristic without a parser

runner_implementable.name: context abstractness around concrete word
runner_implementable.recipe: mean concreteness of window vs focal word

runner_implementable.name: simile/copula markers + dead-vehicle list
runner_implementable.recipe: regex 'like a|as if|as though|is a'; penalize vehicles from a dead-metaphor list (heart, journey, storm, rollercoaster...)

canonical.name: PMI / t-score / Dice collocation strength vs reference corpus
canonical.source: Gablasova et al. 2017; corpus stats methodology

runner_implementable.name: cliché lexicon matching
runner_implementable.recipe: embedded list of stock phrases; hits per token
runner_implementable.weakness: high precision, low recall — misses paraphrased clichés

runner_implementable.name: common-bigram coverage
runner_implementable.recipe: share of adjacent word pairs found in embedded top-bigram table
runner_implementable.weakness: subset covers only most common bigrams

runner_implementable.name: proportion of tokens outside top-N common list
runner_implementable.weakness: threshold arbitrary; OOV includes typos/names; rarity ≠ conceptual novelty (arXiv 2508.05470)

runner_implementable.name: mini concreteness lexicon mean + contrast
runner_implementable.recipe: embedded concrete/abstract word sets; mean level and abstract-concrete co-presence (imagery grounding abstract ideas)
runner_implementable.weakness: small lexicon coverage; direction on creativity is mixed per phase-1 graph

canonical.name: TTCT elaboration rubric
canonical.note: automated proxies conflate verbosity with detail — gameable

runner_implementable.name: modifier density
runner_implementable.recipe: -ly adverbs + embedded adjective list per clause (clauses via re split on punctuation/conjunctions)

runner_implementable.name: adjacent-sentence content-word overlap / TF-cosine
runner_implementable.recipe: set intersection or Counter cosine between the two sentences

runner_implementable.name: OPTIMAL-DISTANCE transform
runner_implementable.recipe: score = 1 - |distance - optimal|/scale — creativity peaks at MODERATE divergence (sweet-spot finding); apply as the functional form on any distance signal instead of monotonic reward
runner_implementable.weakness: optimal point needs calibration per domain
runner_implementable.source: Orwig et al. CCN 2025; coherence-creativity trade-off literature

runner_implementable.name: frequency residualization
runner_implementable.recipe: OLS of context-novelty signal on token rarity via closed-form sums (stdlib math); use residuals as frequency-independent novelty

runner_implementable.name: partial correlation
runner_implementable.recipe: r_xy.z algebra with manual Pearson r

future_work_requires_models: dependency parsing for SPV metaphor detection and entity grids

provenance.phase2_agent: sonnet subagent, 22 WebSearch queries, websearch snippets only (WebFetch 403)
